name: pumi-heeler
description: Heeler's Host for pumi, on the machine's own SSH: a herdr session named pumi, the QR Pairing Code that enrolls a device, and Heeler's Agent Notifications and Live Activities.

session.label: herdr session
session.desc: The name pumi answers as among herdr's sessions (`~/.config/herdr/sessions/<name>/`), so Heeler's Host (its Session name) reaches it. `default`: herdr's own default session (`~/.config/herdr`), where a running herdr server keeps it unless it has stopped. Empty: only pumi's data directory.

ssh_port.label: SSH port
ssh_port.desc: The port the machine's OpenSSH (Remote Login) listens on, which the Pairing Code advertises. 22 unless Remote Login was moved: the plugin starts no SSH server of its own, it pairs against the account's.

default_keys.label: herdr's keys
default_keys.desc: While the plugin runs, bind the prefix table (`C-b` then a key) herdr's way: `v` and `-` split, `h` `j` `k` `l` move, `1`–`9` pick a tab.
